critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1056 lines — consider splitting (owners/branding/report/advisor routes into separate routers) before next iteration.

/api/public/logo/{uid} currently relies on branding.logo_path presence; if a user is deleted after upload, the stored object will be orphaned in Emergent storage — add a delete hook on user removal or on branding remove.

ClientReport.jsx onLogo keeps `brand.logo` (data URI) and `brand.logo_url` (hosted) as two separate fields. This works but doubles the payload stored on the user row. Consider dropping `brand.logo` once the hosted upload succeeds (keep data URI only for the in-browser PDF path).

ReportEmailInput should probably reject obvious test-only domains in production and surface the integration provider's 422 ('undeliverable_recipient') back to the UI more clearly instead of a generic 502.
